title: Affine ind-etale base change along a universal homeomorphism
statement: For a universal homeomorphism r:X→Y with Y affine, pullback induces an equivalence from Y.AffineProEt to X.AffineProEt [def-weil-pbc-ind-etale-basis]. No finiteness assumption on r is imposed.

source.place: Tag 09AB, extending the etale equivalence to ind-etale objects; etale-cohomology.tex Tags 04DZ and 05YX

proof.text: For full faithfulness, present the target as a small cofiltered limit of affine etale schemes. For each etale term, uniqueness of maps after the surjective base change follows by unramifiedness, and existence is etale topological invariance applied to the universal homeomorphism from the base change of the source. Uniqueness implies compatibility of the descended maps. The limit universal property combines them and proves both fullness and faithfulness.

Apply the inverse etale equivalence to the entire presentation of an object over X. Its descended terms are affine by affineness descent along their surjective universally closed projections. Take the limit in affine schemes over Y. The inclusion into schemes preserves cofiltered limits; pullback in the over category preserves limits as a right adjoint. The etale equivalence counit identifies the pulled-back diagram with the original diagram, and uniqueness of limits identifies its limit with the original object. This proves essential surjectivity.
